title: Eyes Up the Ribbon
hook: Yuna on the radio. The highway starts.
scene: Overcast morning on I-5 south of the Core. You have the wheel of the Menace. Nobody else is in the car. The relay kit for Tower 4 is already lashed in the back — repeater, antenna, clamps. The handheld on the floor crackles: Yuna. She will not be here. She wants the interchange, the green panels, and the paint named before you spend the ramp. The mountain is a gray smudge far east. This pavement is the Ribbon.
decision: Where do your eyes go on the approach?

options.text: Name the interchange, the guide panels, and the lane lines ahead
options.result: You call the stack, the green boards, and the skip-dash. She clicks once. The bumper can wait. You already know which gap the next ramp wants.

options.text: Watch the bumper of the car ahead so you do not hit it
options.result: You narrate chrome. The exit panel goes by unread. She has to name the ramp for you. Eyes on the bumper spent the only look that mattered.

options.text: Ask her to stay on until she can talk you through every merge
options.result: The radio is a check, not a second driver. You missed a panel waiting for a voice that will not sit in this seat.

options.text: Slow down in the travel lane so you can read every word on the next sign
options.result: You dump speed on I-5 to finish a sentence. The stack behind you lights. The ramp is where speed dies, not here.

debrief: Interchange, signs, paint — eyes up, not on the bumper.

source.psdp_skill: Skill eleven: highway driving – part one
